findings.reason: Future-state fields removed, but separate event contracts and an acyclic Freeze/Snapshot identity are not complete.
Mirror mismatch no longer mutates Research, but Product can choose the alleged Research trust root itself.
Debt records are separated, but append-only persistence and rollback/truncation protection are missing.
Catalog exists but lacks required record-specific contracts and complete hash/fixture semantics.
Operator verification is semantically incomplete and independent review has no verifier/trust enforcement.
Snapshot CAS exists, but no atomic multi-record governance transaction or unambiguous recovery.
ZIP metadata is deterministic, but complete source/raw-output/package identity binding is not.
Technical and governance models are separated, but the composed Freeze/Snapshot graph is circular.
Locks are named separately, but independent no-new-truth is not cross-validated and is forgeable.
A deterministic ID and basic SemVer checks exist; collision, normalization, change-class and persisted genesis rules do not.
An event fold exists, but snapshots are not derived or verified from the ledger and state projection is inconsistent.
Paths and a mirror helper exist; operational trust anchoring, receipt publication and retention remain incomplete.
The declared coverage exceeds the actually resolvable and executed adversarial test set.
A command/stdout receipt is present, but full source tree, verifier and BA10 artifact inputs are not completely bound.
Freeze starts at schema_version=1 and explicitly declares first_contract_no_predecessor.
Source Contract Lock is mandatory in the baseline/compare contracts, but its inner hash values are not typed as SHA-256.
release_candidate is absent and technical_release_regression is used.
Self-exclusion is implemented, but a complete EvidenceManifest/package identity contract is absent.
